data.one_liner: Define system tray icons and context menus in Flutter desktop apps.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter desktop applications for Windows, macOS, and Linux to display an icon in the system tray, complete with tooltips, custom titles, and native context menus. It exposes event listeners for tray icon clicks and menu interactions.
use_when: Building desktop apps that need to run in the background with a system tray icon
Managing multiple tray icons or dynamic context menus on Windows, macOS, or Linux
avoid_when: You require full click handling on Linux tray panels (which control menu behavior natively)
strengths: Cross-platform support for Windows, macOS, and Linux
Supports multiple tray icons simultaneously via the native API
Includes a legacy bridge for easy migration from older versions
weaknesses: Linux system tray depends on desktop environment capabilities (e.g., GNOME requires the AppIndicator extension)
Some platform-specific methods are ignored or have no effect depending on the operating system
data.setup_notes: Linux build machines require GTK 3, X11, and Xi development files (e.g., libgtk-3-dev, libx11-dev, libxi-dev).
